source_documents.title: A theoretical investigation on the excited-state decay and anti-kasha fluorescence of phenanthrene dithiadiazolyl radical

reference_evidence_units.quote: Eight-state-averaged CASSCF calculations with equal weights
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: SA8-CASSCF(11,10) geometries; SDSPT2 refined energies; FCclasses rates at 300 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper computes minima and conical intersections with a multireference treatment, rather than reporting a new emission experiment.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Methods pp.3-4; the rate model uses harmonic/adiabatic-Hessian approximations and excludes Herzberg-Teller corrections. SI was not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The geometrical parameters for D3-min are nearly identical with those of D0-min
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.statement: D3-min retains the approximately -46.5 degree torsion, whereas D1-min is nearly planar (-0.8 degree); this links relaxation to interfragment torsion.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Stationary points do not determine actual branching fractions. The authors could not locate a D3/D2 CI.

reference_evidence_units.quote: which hinders the DTDA twisting motion
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PDTDA in rigid polystyrene film; earlier experiment cited as reference 12.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign the previously reported 360 nm film emission to a D1 Franck-Condon-region geometry maintained by hindered twisting.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a main-text interpretation of an earlier experiment, not a newly measured film or personally inspected earlier paper. Do not transfer this assignment to free solution.

reference_evidence_units.quote: radiative and non- radiative decay rate constants at D₁-min were 2.42 × 104 s−1 and 5.44 × 1011 s−1, respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Relaxed D1 minimum, 300 K rate calculation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The D1 minimum is predicted to be nearly nonemissive, with nonradiative decay vastly faster than radiative decay; its computed 602 nm emission disagrees with the cited 410 nm solution band.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The comparison mixes gas-phase calculations with earlier solution measurements. The source Figure 6 depicts 2.05 eV, whereas prose gives 2.06 eV.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the system sequentially decays via conical in­ tersections CI-D5/D6, CI-D4/D5, and CI-D3/D4.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: SDSPT2 GIIC potential-energy profiles after excitation to D6; Fig.6 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Torsional relaxation is assigned to successive D6/D5, D5/D4 and D4/D3 intersection regions, followed by branching toward D3-min or D1-min through D2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The exact quote preserves the PDF soft hyphen. Two CASSCF CIs acquire 0.22/0.36 eV gaps after SDSPT2 correction; D3/D2 crossing remains inferred, not optimized.

reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: D3 minimum, 300 K harmonic rate calculation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: D3-min has predicted radiative and nonradiative rates of 4.40e5 and 1.65e5 s^-1, respectively; computed emission is 362 nm.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: These are local-minimum rates, not an overall measured fluorescence yield or population trajectory; calculated emission differs from 380 nm THF and 410 nm MeCN values cited from prior work.

reference_evidence_units.quote: D3 → D0 radiative decay with anti-Kasha character is the possible origin of fluorescence of isolated PDTDA molecule.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Isolated-molecule theoretical interpretation contrasted with earlier solvent emission.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source proposes D3-to-D0 anti-Kasha fluorescence rather than emission from relaxed D1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The wording is a possible origin; no direct experimental state assignment is made in this paper. Do not generalize the assignment to the rigid-film condition.

reference_evidence_units.quote: electron exchange between phenanthrene and DTDA rings was identified
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Electronic-configuration analysis along the computed relaxation pathway, Fig.7 and main-text section 3.4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign interfragment electron exchange to the nonradiative pathway and distinguish double-excitation character allowing D3 radiation from D1 configurations unfavorable for radiation.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a multiconfigurational electron-exchange interpretation, not measured redox chemistry or a proven conventional donor-acceptor TICT state. Tables S4-S8 were not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: could suppress non-radiative population losses, thereby enhancing fluorescence quantum yields.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PDTDA radical
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Concluding proposed restriction of phenanthrene/DTDA torsion.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors explicitly suggest torsional restriction as a strategy to reduce nonradiative loss and increase fluorescence yield.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a theoretical design proposal, not an experimentally established aggregation-induced-emission mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Preserve the explicit hindered-torsion film interpretation and proposed torsional-restriction strategy, bounded as theory and cited prior-film evidence, not demonstrated AIE.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The rigid polystyrene environment is explicitly invoked to hinder twisting and select film emission; evidence is a discussion of prior work.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Interfragment electron exchange is explicitly proposed in the computed relaxation mechanism. This family is used in its broad electron-transfer sense, not as experimentally verified PET.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Computed rates and electronic configurations distinguish a nearly dark relaxed D1 from emissive D3; local rate competition does not determine the total quantum yield.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Computed intersection-mediated torsional relaxation competes with D3 emission. It is CI-mediated decay, with incomplete crossing localization, not proven aggregate restriction of CI access.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The central proposed isolated-PDTDA emission pathway is D3-to-D0 anti-Kasha fluorescence; retain uncertainty and environment dependence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
